name: Longshine Technology Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Longshine Technology Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in software development in China and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Energy Digitalization, Internet TV, and Energy Internet. It offers living payment, OTTTV, and intelligent travel solutions, as well as sports management service platform, digital intelligence class, city operation center, intelligent community, and Beijing and all-in-one system for government and enterprises. The company also provides power marketing management, integrated energy service, and overseas power marketing system; HanClouds industrial internet platform; digital finance service platform; electricity approach…
